records.Entity / project type: Bitcoin brokerage / ATM and self-custody on-ramp
records.Concise description: Canadian-founded Bitcoin company offering online buy/sell flows that deliver BTC to user-controlled wallets, plus ATM and OTC infrastructure.
records.Deeper researched summary: Bitcoin Well began with a Bitcoin ATM in Alberta and evolved into a Bitcoin-focused online portal. Its current model emphasizes self-custody: users enter a Bitcoin address for purchases rather than accumulating an exchange wallet balance, while sell flows can exchange BTC for bank deposits where supported. The company also retains ATM and OTC lineage, making it a useful bridge between physical and online Bitcoin on-ramps.
records.Launch / history: The business idea began in 2013; its first Alberta Bitcoin ATM followed in 2014. The company later consolidated under the Bitcoin Well brand and launched its online portal in the 2020s.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Bitcoin Well documents the evolution from early physical Bitcoin ATMs to direct-to-wallet online brokerage while keeping Bitcoin as the product focus.
Important technical or cultural characte: BTC sale to fiat rails where supported
records.Verification basis: Current Bitcoin Well first-party company and product pages verify active operation, founder/history and self-custody-oriented buy/sell model.
Research notes / uncertainties: ATM availability and banking rails are location-specific and time-sensitive.
Do not imply Bitcoin Well holds user keys for its direct-to-wallet purchase flow.

records.Concise description: European Bitcoin-only app that brokers BTC purchases and sends bitcoin to user-controlled wallet infrastructure rather than operating a conventional custodial order book.
records.Deeper researched summary: Relai launched in Switzerland as a Bitcoin-only savings and purchase app and emphasizes self-custody. Users can buy bitcoin and hold it in a wallet for which they control the backup; newer flows also support direct delivery to compatible hardware wallets. Relai's European regulatory structure changed as MiCA took effect, so legal availability must be described by dated entity/jurisdiction rather than as a timeless EU-wide fact.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2020 in Switzerland. Relai expanded across Europe and migrated parts of its EU offering into a MiCA-era structure during 2025–2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: It is a major European example of Bitcoin-only brokerage combined with self-custody rather than a multiasset custodial exchange account.
records.Verification basis: Current Relai product and 2025–2026 company/regulatory communications verify active Bitcoin-only self-custody brokerage; regulatory copy remains date-sensitive.
Research notes / uncertainties: MiCA authorization/passporting claims are time-sensitive; cite the responsible entity and competent authority when public copy is drafted.
Do not call Relai an order-book exchange.

records.Concise description: Swiss Bitcoin-only broker designed to convert bank transfers into bitcoin delivered directly to a user's wallet.
records.Deeper researched summary: Pocket Bitcoin centers its model on direct settlement to self-custody rather than a custodial exchange account. Users connect a wallet address and can automate purchases from bank transfers; current product material also documents Lightning-related buy/sell functionality. Fiat movement relies on conventional payment rails and service providers, so 'non-custodial' describes the bitcoin custody model rather than eliminating all intermediaries.
Creators / founders: Pocket Bitcoin founding team — individual founder attribution not re-verified from current first-party material
records.Launch / history: Pocket Bitcoin developed in Switzerland as a Bitcoin-only bank-transfer-to-wallet service and has expanded its direct-purchase and Lightning-related capabilities.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: Pocket is a clean example of the recurring bank-transfer broker model where bitcoin is delivered to the user's wallet rather than accumulated on a trading venue.
Important technical or cultural characte: Lightning-related purchase/sale support in current product material
records.Verification basis: Current Pocket Bitcoin first-party product and help material verifies active direct-to-wallet brokerage and current Lightning-related functionality; founder attribution remains intentionally unresolved.
Research notes / uncertainties: Founder attribution should not be published as settled until a current first-party source is captured.
Payment-provider and country availability can change and should be reverified before public copy.

records.Entity / project type: Custodial Bitcoin brokerage / wallet / payments platform
records.Concise description: Isle of Man-founded Bitcoin company offering BTC buy/sell, custodial storage, transfers and Lightning-enabled services.
records.Deeper researched summary: CoinCorner began in 2014 with the goal of making Bitcoin accessible and has remained Bitcoin-focused while adding mobile wallet, Lightning and business payment products. Bitcoin kept on CoinCorner is custodial; the company describes cold-storage and multisignature infrastructure, while users can also send and withdraw bitcoin. CoinCorner acquired UK exchange Coinfloor in 2021; the acquired exchange is treated as lineage rather than a duplicate canonical profile.
records.Launch / history: Founded in 2014 on the Isle of Man. CoinCorner later expanded to multiple markets and acquired Coinfloor's customer base in 2021.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin exchange e: CoinCorner is a long-lived Bitcoin-focused regional platform and one of the earlier exchange businesses to integrate Lightning into customer deposit/withdrawal/payment workflows.
Important technical or cultural characte: Custodial storage while funds remain on platform
records.Verification basis: Current CoinCorner official site/About material verifies active operation, 2014 origin, Bitcoin focus and custody model; current help material was checked for Lightning support.
Research notes / uncertainties: Lightning functionality was verified in current CoinCorner help material during this research pass; exact feature availability remains jurisdiction/account dependent.
Coinfloor is consolidated as historical lineage rather than a second current profile.
